failure_modes: Selecting a temporal_teacher_blend (C009-C011) or temporal_region_index (C008) would change teacher coordinates or regional attention based only on non-extrapolable descriptive contrast fits, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates without demonstrated affinity benefit.

Selecting a narrower or broader teacher_neighbors count (C005/C007) would alter mode coverage and competing directions without supplied intact-teacher dispersion or joint-geometry evidence; neighbor count is not a distance bandwidth.

Selecting a pointcloud_delta_A value other than the incumbent 1.0 (C001/C003) would change distance-response curvature without supplied spatial-scale or uncertainty evidence, and C002 is already the incumbent value.
Any temperature edit is an interface violation and is not proposed; fixed_parameters mixture_temperature=0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0 are preserved.
rationale: Analyst's temporal evidence is descriptive only: the continuous contrast fits are observed-node linear fits with polynomial_accepted false, extrapolation_allowed false, and relative node RMSE roughly 0.29-0.78, so they are not absolute reward targets or extrapolable trajectories (F003, F004). H001 is therefore conditional on a registered temporal recipe reproducing the sign changes, and H002 only rejects a single signed whole-window contrast; neither establishes a defensible expected affinity advantage for a specific offered edit. The offered choices are pointcloud_delta_A (C001-C003), region_index (C004), teacher_neighbors (C005-C007), temporal_region_index (C008) and temporal_teacher_blend (C009-C011). The incumbent already uses pointcloud_delta_A=1.0 (C002) and teacher_neighbors=4 (C006), so those are not edits. The remaining choices would change dose, regional attention or teacher coordinates without any supplied spatial-scale, dispersion or joint-geometry evidence read in this turn to justify a curvature, bandwidth or blend value; the objective is affinity-primary and no decoded terminal affinity outcome is available to this role, so no offered change has a defensible expected advantage. Retaining the incumbent is the evidence-supported action.
